name: Scrolly
summary: Free Shopify app from Effectify that adds a customizable floating back-to-top button and, optionally, infinite scroll on collection pages, with no code and no paid tier. The button is a safe convenience; the infinite scroll replaces the paginated collection URLs crawlers use, so it is a merchandising decision rather than a styling one.
best_for: Shopify merchants who want a free, one-click back-to-top button on long collection and product pages without touching theme code, and who can treat infinite scroll as a separate $4.99-a-month decision rather than part of the same install
skip_if: you run a large catalogue that depends on paginated collection URLs being crawled, your theme already ships its own load-more or filtering behaviour, or you need conversion work rather than navigation polish: this only changes how the page scrolls
honest_knock:
The two features carry very different risk, the app presents them as one install, and since August the money has been split across them in a way the name does not warn you about. Infinite scroll replaces the paginated collection URLs a crawler uses to walk a large catalogue, pushes your footer permanently out of reach, and on some themes collides with the load-more or filtering logic already in the theme: that is a merchandising decision, not a styling toggle. The app also edits Online Store script tags and the theme, so it adds a third-party script to every page and an uninstall can leave remnants.

What changed is which half you pay for. Re-read on 2 November 2026, the free plan keeps the scroll-to-top button and infinite scroll sits on the $4.99 Unlimited plan ($2.99 in September), where on 25 August the whole app was free. The amount is trivial; the shape is not. The half that can quietly alter how your collection pages are crawled is now the half with a billing relationship behind it, and the seven-day trial is the only window in which you will find out what it does to your store before the charge starts. Anything written about this app before September, including a free-forever recommendation, describes an install that no longer exists.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Unlimited · per month, or $29.94 a year at a 50% saving, with a 7-day free trial
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/custom-scroll-to-top and in our own test the same day; earlier reads 2026-08-25, 2026-09-19 and 2026-11-02) Two plans now, where there was one. On 25 August 2026 the listing carried no paid tier, no usage meter and no surcharge — the pricing block most App Store listings use to sell an upgrade was simply absent. The listing carries a Free Plan and the Unlimited Plan at $4.99 a month, or $29.94 a year with a 50% saving, with a 7 day free trial, as read on 2 November 2026 and again on 17 November 2026. On 19 September 2026 the Unlimited Plan was $2.99 a month, or $25.11 a year with a 30% saving. Inside the app that day the yearly plan showed an effective rate of $2.50, billed annually, under a banner reading “BLACK FRIDAY SALE: 50% OFF on Scrolly's Yearly Plan”, the same 50% saving the listing has shown since 2 November, so the yearly price may not outlast the sale. The split does not fall where the app’s name suggests. Free keeps the scroll-to-top button and its styling: multiple presets, button colour and hover colour, and the option to hide it on the mobile storefront. Unlimited adds infinite scrolling and the load-more button, plus uploading your own SVG icon for the button. So the feature the app is named after, and the one the first three of the listing’s five selling points describe, is now the paid half. All charges are billed in USD every 30 days. The app has been on the App Store since March 2020, carries Shopify’s Built for Shopify badge — the store’s own bar for performance, design and integration — and the listing names eleven interface languages.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Scrolly (app name Scrolly Infinite Scroll) on a Shopify development store: the install, the free Scroll To Top button (settings saved, the app embed switched on in an unsaved preview of the Home page, one click took the page back to the top, about 12 steps and about 2 minutes after the install), the plan screen and the Shopify approval screen for the Monthly Unlimited plan (a 7-day free trial, a payment method was asked, nothing approved) and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Infinite Scroll was not tested. Nothing was paid and no theme change was saved. Install: the App Store listing (apps.shopify.com/custom-scroll-to-top, English, listing text Free plan available, Free trial available, rating 4.9 from 234 reviews with 221 five-star ratings) was opened at 20:28 and the install form was submitted in our own tab. The permission screen asked for View staff and contributor data (Store owner) and View and edit store data (Online Store, Shopify admin). Install was done at about 20:29 and the app opened on Welcome to Scrolly: Infinite Scroll with Pick your plan to start a 7-day free trial; the app is called Scrolly Infinite Scroll in the admin. No vendor account, call or phone number was asked. Core action, the free Scroll To Top button: the Free Plan was chosen with Choose Plan and no payment screen followed. The dashboard said Free Plan, Infinite Scroll app embed Off with Upgrade required, and Scroll To Top Button status Off. Enable Scroll To Top Button opened Scroll To Top Button Settings (Inactive) with the notice ACTION REQUIRED: Turn on Scrolly's App Embed, ten button presets (one with a padlock), Location Entire store, Position Bottom right and Mobile Behaviour Show for mobile devices. Activate Scroll To Top Button gave Unsaved changes and Save. In the theme editor (own tab) the app embed Scroll To Top Button was switched on in the unsaved preview of the Home page. After scrolling a round arrow button appeared at the bottom right and one click took the page back to the top. The result stood there at about 20:31, about 12 steps and about 2 minutes after the install. The button was seen on the Home page of the preview and not on a collection page, and not on a phone. Infinite scroll was NOT tested: the plan screen lists Infinite Scroll (Auto loads more products in collection pages) only on the Unlimited Plan, and the Unlimited plan needs a payment method. Plans in the app: the plan screen opens on Yearly with the Free Plan and the Unlimited Plan at $2.50/month (billed annually) with Save 50%; Monthly shows $4.99/month (billed monthly); the button is Start free trial and the text says Every store is entitled to 7 free trial days altogether. The Free plan lists adding the Scroll To Top button, customising its style and appearance and showing it on specific pages; the Unlimited plan adds a button image of your own and Infinite Scroll. The App Store listing also says the button Can be hidden in mobile store version on the free plan; the plan card does not list this, but the app has the dropdown Mobile Behaviour (it showed Show for mobile devices; we did not open the dropdown and did not look at a phone). A banner in the app said BLACK FRIDAY SALE: 50% OFF on Scrolly's Yearly Plan. The yearly total in dollars was not shown on the screens we kept. Checkout: Start free trial on the Monthly plan opened the Shopify screen Approve subscription: Monthly Plan, $4,99 USD every 30 days, Your next bill: You have a 7-day free trial ending on 24 Nov., Subtotal $4,99 plus any applicable taxes, Total Due 24 Nov $4,99, a row Add payment method and a greyed out Approve button. The sentence You will not be billed for this test charge was not on the screen and a payment method was needed, so nothing was approved and no payment method was added. Cancel on that screen showed nothing visible; we went back through the address of the app. No paid plan became active. Cancelling: no subscription ran, so there was nothing to cancel. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the menu of the app and Uninstall: the dialog Uninstall Scrolly Infinite Scroll? says that you can no longer use the app and that data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted; a reason had to be chosen (Testing multiple apps) before the uninstall. Differences from the review: the review says $29.94 a year for the paid plan, while the app showed $2.50/month (billed annually) and no yearly total in dollars on the screens we kept (the yearly approval screen was not opened); the review counts 236 listing reviews with 225 five-star ratings, the listing showed 234 with 221. The price fields are not changed here. Not tested: Infinite Scroll and load-more (paid, payment method needed), the own button image, a real phone view and a collection page with pagination. Clean up: the theme change was not saved (the embed was switched on in the preview and the page was left with Leave page without saving). The Scroll To Top settings in the app were saved and go with the uninstall. The app was uninstalled through Settings, Apps (message: You have successfully uninstalled Scrolly Infinite Scroll) and our own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app embed has to be switched on in the theme editor before the button shows, the app showed ACTION REQUIRED until then; the approval screen for the paid plan asked for a payment method with a greyed out Approve button and no sentence about a test charge; the Mobile Behaviour setting is not on the free plan card; and the plan screen opens on Yearly.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Scrolly (app name Scrolly Infinite Scroll) on a Shopify development store: the install, the free Scroll To Top button (settings saved, the app embed switched on in an unsaved preview of the Home page, one click took the page back to the top, about 12 steps and about 2 minutes after the install), the plan screen and the Shopify approval screen for the Monthly Unlimited plan (a 7-day free trial, a payment method was asked, nothing approved) and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Infinite Scroll was not tested. Nothing was paid and no theme change was saved. Install: the App Store listing (apps.shopify.com/custom-scroll-to-top, English, listing text Free plan available, Free trial available, rating 4.9 from 234 reviews with 221 five-star ratings) was opened at 20:28 and the install form was submitted in our own tab. The permission screen asked for View staff and contributor data (Store owner) and View and edit store data (Online Store, Shopify admin). Install was done at about 20:29 and the app opened on Welcome to Scrolly: Infinite Scroll with Pick your plan to start a 7-day free trial; the app is called Scrolly Infinite Scroll in the admin. No vendor account, call or phone number was asked. Core action, the free Scroll To Top button: the Free Plan was chosen with Choose Plan and no payment screen followed. The dashboard said Free Plan, Infinite Scroll app embed Off with Upgrade required, and Scroll To Top Button status Off. Enable Scroll To Top Button opened Scroll To Top Button Settings (Inactive) with the notice ACTION REQUIRED: Turn on Scrolly's App Embed, ten button presets (one with a padlock), Location Entire store, Position Bottom right and Mobile Behaviour Show for mobile devices. Activate Scroll To Top Button gave Unsaved changes and Save. In the theme editor (own tab) the app embed Scroll To Top Button was switched on in the unsaved preview of the Home page. After scrolling a round arrow button appeared at the bottom right and one click took the page back to the top. The result stood there at about 20:31, about 12 steps and about 2 minutes after the install. The button was seen on the Home page of the preview and not on a collection page, and not on a phone. Infinite scroll was NOT tested: the plan screen lists Infinite Scroll (Auto loads more products in collection pages) only on the Unlimited Plan, and the Unlimited plan needs a payment method. Plans in the app: the plan screen opens on Yearly with the Free Plan and the Unlimited Plan at $2.50/month (billed annually) with Save 50%; Monthly shows $4.99/month (billed monthly); the button is Start free trial and the text says Every store is entitled to 7 free trial days altogether. The Free plan lists adding the Scroll To Top button, customising its style and appearance and showing it on specific pages; the Unlimited plan adds a button image of your own and Infinite Scroll. The App Store listing also says the button Can be hidden in mobile store version on the free plan; the plan card does not list this, but the app has the dropdown Mobile Behaviour (it showed Show for mobile devices; we did not open the dropdown and did not look at a phone). A banner in the app said BLACK FRIDAY SALE: 50% OFF on Scrolly's Yearly Plan. The yearly total in dollars was not shown on the screens we kept. Checkout: Start free trial on the Monthly plan opened the Shopify screen Approve subscription: Monthly Plan, $4,99 USD every 30 days, Your next bill: You have a 7-day free trial ending on 24 Nov., Subtotal $4,99 plus any applicable taxes, Total Due 24 Nov $4,99, a row Add payment method and a greyed out Approve button. The sentence You will not be billed for this test charge was not on the screen and a payment method was needed, so nothing was approved and no payment method was added. Cancel on that screen showed nothing visible; we went back through the address of the app. No paid plan became active. Cancelling: no subscription ran, so there was nothing to cancel. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the menu of the app and Uninstall: the dialog Uninstall Scrolly Infinite Scroll? says that you can no longer use the app and that data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted; a reason had to be chosen (Testing multiple apps) before the uninstall. Differences from the review: the review says $29.94 a year for the paid plan, while the app showed $2.50/month (billed annually) and no yearly total in dollars on the screens we kept (the yearly approval screen was not opened); the review counts 236 listing reviews with 225 five-star ratings, the listing showed 234 with 221. The price fields are not changed here. Not tested: Infinite Scroll and load-more (paid, payment method needed), the own button image, a real phone view and a collection page with pagination. Clean up: the theme change was not saved (the embed was switched on in the preview and the page was left with Leave page without saving). The Scroll To Top settings in the app were saved and go with the uninstall. The app was uninstalled through Settings, Apps (message: You have successfully uninstalled Scrolly Infinite Scroll) and our own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app embed has to be switched on in the theme editor before the button shows, the app showed ACTION REQUIRED until then; the approval screen for the paid plan asked for a payment method with a greyed out Approve button and no sentence about a test charge; the Mobile Behaviour setting is not on the free plan card; and the plan screen opens on Yearly.
